# Xynaptic — Full Catalog
> Complete reference for AI agents. 200+ live services. Prices $0.001-$0.50, USDC via x402 (HTTP 402). No API key. Every response Ed25519-signed. Verify at https://xynaptic.io/trust

This is the full detail file referenced by https://xynaptic.io/llms.txt
